text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 declares `_meta.claudeCode.promptQueueing`. A `session/prompt` sent during a turn gets its own reply, in order. Claude Code hands it to the model only with the next tool result, so behind a foreground subagent it waits until the subagent returns (13 s in a 2026-11-11 log). A `session/cancel` cancels every prompt received so far. Source: `startTurn` and `cancelTurns` in the adapter's bundled JavaScript.
